rows.reason: Summ great bone is unmistakably the Abyss's and makes the ship a nursery; fold lamp's lane only matters back in the Dark, elsewhere it is a plain fuel heater (overlap noted below).
Owner card; blue-ice blackout cold hold is the biome's own and ship-relevant.
Vexxith hull liner is a whole-ship acid skin; best of the four Cauldron candidates for a ship.
Ruled device as a hardpoint; powerful and unique.
Literal scrapbook trophy from the skeleton seams; numbers sane (skeleton item beauty 8, case 14, MV 140 input). Optional: beauty could rise toward ~20 given rarity and no quality roll.
Sekkulaath tank is the swamp's own captive producer; lure stake is ground-only in spirit.
Archive vat is powerful, unique, works aboard (power + raw slime + spacer comps).

RM_ToxinSealedFloor's only function is stopping a greatbole regrowing a mined cell (RM_MapComponent_LivingRegrowth); on a deck it is pathCost 14, beauty -1 placeholder PavedTile, and its text is about 'chamber floor' and 'living wood beneath' - nonsensical aboard and worse than steel tile. 'Toxin-sealed decking' over-claims.
rows.change: Drop RM_ToxinSealedFloor from the row; the gift is RM_DryAirBlower alone.

rows.reason: Glow-forever floor and wall: genuinely the Deeps', useful on a ship.
Only deck candidate the biome has; its own device. Overlaps Weeping Stones (see duplicates).
Lure is a toggle (off = ordinary furniture, RM_ShadeExtras.cs), shade-gear footprint shade answers the Direct Sun; better than the wrecked cart junk prop.
Power from rot in delta loam/silt/salt is biome-specific and ship-useful.

Fiction matches RM_FurnaceHide ('has not entirely stopped'); fuel-free 6 heat/s capped 21 C is modest-but-free, fine for a ship; 60 hide + 20 steel reasonable. (Owner's 'burning statues' example is the FlameStatues mod, tied to Sump gas, not Pyrelands.)
Self-mending hull from live pattern metal is the cathedral's own trick and strong; 480 HP vs GravshipHull 420, 8 dead smartsteel + 1 live ingot (MV 14, stack 75) per section is a fair premium.

Unbalanced for its cost: tellurox butcher yields 6 shells, so 2 per tile = 3 tiles per beast killed, for beauty 3 (below silver tile) and nothing a ship feels. A deck floor needs tens of tiles; as built it is a chore, not a gift.
rows.change: Cost 1 RM_TelluroxShell per tile (6 tiles per beast) and raise Beauty to 5-6 so the scarred hexplate is the best-looking non-precious floor aboard; keep Flammability 0, CleaningTimeFactor 0.6.

rows.reason: Owner-typed lens chain; fuel-free open-deck still and lance.

Cryoponics vat needs continuous power and grows only Chill plants. The same biome's RM_SunSphere (inventory: deck-placeable) cultures into its own small sun that lights and grows crops with no well or lamp - a clearly stronger, more distinctive ship gift (owner: powerful tech).
rows.change: Make RM_SunSphere the headline gift; keep RM_ChillCryoponicsVat as second def.

rows.reason: Owner card; airtight floatstone hull and door.
Swallowed drive core (range multiplier) is a superb ship gift; living mat root fine.
Owner's own examples.
Owner turn; clean-air dome plus glower panel.
Shielded cask bay is the Wastes' gravship waste run; Steel/Plasteel kit but its function belongs to this biome only.
Fabric tether lance is Webwork's; only candidate.
Unique last-working gorrask condenser, text says install it on a ship.

duplicates: Leaning Scrub RM_WindVaporator vs Weeping Stones RM_AncientCondenserPlant: both pull water from air aboard (powered/buildable vs unpowered/unique) - near-duplicate function; neither biome has another deck candidate, so keep both but state the difference in the rows.

Pyrelands RM_FurnaceHideBank vs The Rot RM_LivingMatRoot vs Abyss RM_FoldLamp: three cabin warmers; distinct mechanisms (passive hide, fed creeping mat, fuel lamp), acceptable, but the Abyss fold lamp is the weakest and could be dropped to leave the great bone alone.
Blue Desert RM_ColdSinkRack vs Greentide RM_DryAirBlower: both cool a room; distinct enough (powerless blackout cold store vs fueled no-exhaust cooler with dry-air curtain).
